Name: allowdetailcracks (Tools++)
Description: Don't fixup t-junctions on func_detail

Name: allowdynamicpropsasstatic (Tools++)
Description: Allow props without allowstatic to be static props

Name: Append content search paths
Description: Add an extra search path behind the ones from gameinfo.txt Multiple paths can be specified with a , (comma)

Name: asw (Tools++)
Description: Use Alien-Swarm compatible BSP format

Name: Game base directory
Description: Path to the game's base directory, deduced from the mod directory by default

Name: block (Tools++)
Description: Control the grid size mins/maxs that the map is chopped on

Name: blocks (Tools++)
Description: Control the grid dimensions that the map is chopped on
Warning: Compiler default: N N N N.

Name: blocksize (Tools++)
Description: Control the size of each grid square that vbsp chops the level on

Name: Box3D physics
Description: Load vphysics_box3d to generate collision data

Name: BSP format
Description: BSP version to write. Supported versions: 19    (HL2) 20    (TF2) 21    (ASW/L4D2/Portal 2/CS:GO)

Name: bumpall (Tools++)
Description: Force all surfaces to be bump mapped

Name: csgo (Tools++)
Description: Use CS:GO compatible BSP format

Name: csgoclipcontents (Tools++)
Description: Compile CS:GO grenadeclip/droneclip contents

Name: cullall (Tools++)
Description: Force all forms of culling

Name: cullbrushes (Tools++)
Description: Always cull brushes, even if limit isn't exceeded yet

Name: cullbrushsides (Tools++)
Description: Always cull brushsides, even if limit isn't exceeded yet

Name: cullplanes (Tools++)
Description: Always cull planes, even if limit isn't exceeded yet

Name: cullplanesaggressive (Tools++)
Description: Force aggressive plane culling

Name: cullverts (Tools++)
Description: Always cull vertexes, even if limit isn't exceeded yet

Name: defaultcubemap (Tools++)
Description: Obsolete (on by default). Generates default LDR and HDR cubemaps

Name: defaultluxelsize (Tools++)
Description: Set the default luxel scale if a face has no lightmap scale

Name: dumpcollide (Tools++)
Description: Write files with collision info

Name: dumpstaticprop (Tools++)
Description: Dump static props to staticprop*.txt

Name: dxlevel (Tools++)
Description: Don't include entities whose dxlevels preclude this dxlevel

Name: embed (Tools++)
Description: Use an additional search path for assets

Name: entfirst (Tools++)
Description: Set the entity classname to sort first in the entity list

Name: forcematerial (Tools++)
Description: Force all brushes to use this material

Name: forceskyvis (Tools++)
Description: Enable vis calculations in 3d skybox leaves

Name: fulldetail (Tools++)
Description: Mark all detail geometry as normal geometry

Name: Game directory (managed by app)
Description: Path to the mod directory holding gameinfo.txt

Name: glview (Tools++)
Description: Writes.gl files in the current directory that can be viewed with glview

Name: Prepend content search paths
Description: Add an extra search path in front of the ones from gameinfo.txt Multiple paths can be specified with a , (comma)

Name: insurgency (Tools++)
Description: Use Insurgency compatible BSP format

Name: keepstalezip (Tools++)
Description: Keep the BSP's zip files intact but regenerate everything else

Name: l4d2 (Tools++)
Description: Use Left 4 Dead 2 compatible BSP format

Name: leaktest (Tools++)
Description: Obsolete (on by default). Stop processing the map if a leak is detected

Name: lightformat (Tools++)
Description: World light version to write. Supported versions: 0     (HL2/TF2) 1     (ASW/L4D2/Portal 2/CS:GO)

Name: lightifmissing (Tools++)
Description: Force lightmaps to be generated for all surfaces even if they don't need lightmaps

Name: low (Tools++)
Description: Run as an idle-priority process

Name: luxelscale (Tools++)
Description: Scale all lightmaps by this amount

Name: materialdebug (Tools++)
Description: Print debug information about materials

Name: maxbrushes (Tools++)
Description: Set maximum brush limit

Name: maxbrushsides (Tools++)
Description: Set maximum brushsides limit

Name: maxdispinfo (Tools++)
Description: Set maximum displacement limit

Name: maxlightmapdim (Tools++)
Description: Maximum lightmap dimension a face can have before splitting

Name: maxluxelscale (Tools++)
Description: No luxel scale will be higher than this amount

Name: maxtexinfo (Tools++)
Description: Set maximum texinfo limit

Name: micro (Tools++)
Description: Warn when brushes are output with a volume less than this number

Name: minluxelscale (Tools++)
Description: No luxel scale will be lower than this amount

Name: missingmaterial (Tools++)
Description: Replace missing brush materials with this material

Name: Content mount configuration
Description: Path to a mount.cfg listing extra content to mount Intended for Garry's Mod

Name: nobevel (Tools++)
Description: Don't bevel solids for collision

Name: nobump (Tools++)
Description: Disable bumpmap lightmaps on all surface

Name: nocsg (Tools++)
Description: Don't chop out intersecting brush areas

Name: nocull (Tools++)
Description: Don't reduce brushes, brushsides, vertexes or planes

Name: nodefaultcubemap (Tools++)
Description: Don't generate default LDR and HDR cubemaps

Name: nodetail (Tools++)
Description: Get rid of all detail geometry

Name: nodetailclip (Tools++)
Description: Don't clip detail brush faces with each other

Name: nodisp4virtualmesh (Tools++)
Description: Enable physics compression for power of 4 displacements

Name: nodrawtriggers (Tools++)
Description: Compiles all triggers as if they were using the Nodraw texture

Name: nohdrcubemap (Tools++)
Description: Don't generate default HDR cubemaps (for maps that will be LDR only)

Name: noineligiblevertexlitprops (Tools++)
Description: Don't mark bumpmap/phong props as not supporting vertex lighting

Name: noldrcubemap (Tools++)
Description: Don't generate default LDR cubemaps (for maps that will be HDR only)

Name: noleaktest (Tools++)
Description: Continue processing the map if a leak is detected

Name: nomerge (Tools++)
Description: Don't merge together chopped faces on nodes

Name: nomergewater (Tools++)
Description: Don't merge together chopped faces on water

Name: nonamefixup (Tools++)
Description: Disable default name prefixing for instance collapsing

Name: noopt (Tools++)
Description: Preserves the 'outer shell' of the map, which are all the faces you can't see because you can never get outside the map

Name: nophysics (Tools++)
Description: Don't generate physics collision for the map

Name: noprune (Tools++)
Description: Don't prune neighboring solid nodes

Name: noshare (Tools++)
Description: Emit unique face edges instead of sharing them

Name: nostyledlights (Tools++)
Description: Named lights become static lights, or are removed if initially dark

Name: nosubdiv (Tools++)
Description: Don't subdivide faces for lightmapping

Name: notjunc (Tools++)
Description: Don't fixup t-junctions

Name: novirtualmesh (Tools++)
Description: Disable physics compression for displacements

Name: nowater (Tools++)
Description: Get rid of water brushes

Name: noweld (Tools++)
Description: Don't join face vertices together

Name: onlyents (Tools++)
Description: Only import the entities from the VMF. Brush models are not re-imported

Name: onlyprops (Tools++)
Description: Only update the static props and detail props

Name: portal2 (Tools++)
Description: Use Portal 2 compatible BSP format

Name: replacematerials (Tools++)
Description: Substitute materials according to cfg/materialsub.cfg file

Name: report_search_paths (Tools++)
Description: Show search paths for assets

Name: showineligiblevertexlitprops (Tools++)
Description: Show what props got marked as not supporting vertex lighting

Name: simpleladders (Tools++)
Description: Write ladders in func_simpleladder format like L4D

Name: singleplayer (Tools++)
Description: Use SDK 2013 singleplayer compatible BSP format

Name: snapaxial (Tools++)
Description: Snap axial planes to integer coordinates

Name: staticpropformat (Tools++)
Description: Static prop version to write. Supported versions: 6      (HL2) 7 8    (L4D) 9      (L4D2) 10_TF2 (TF2) 10     (Insurgency) 11 12  (CSGO) 13     (Strata) 14     (MvZ)

Name: Worker threads
Description: Number of threads to use. Defaults to max CPU thread count

Name: v (Tools++)
Description: Turn on verbose output

Name: verbose (Tools++)
Description: Turn on verbose output

Name: verboseentities (Tools++)
Description: Disables verbose output for submodels

Name: warnmissinginstances (Tools++)
Description: Warn when instances are missing instead of erroring

Name: xbox (Tools++)
Description: Enable mandatory xbox options
